t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop website section as a flat straight-on UI mockup on a warm limestone background. Small eyebrow label, then an oversized light-weight navy sans headline in sentence case across the full width. Left half: a square-cornered deep navy panel showing a macro of a pipe joint bead drawn as dense fine white contour lines, overlaid with hairline dimension lines and tiny mono measurements. Right half: a short lead sentence and a numbered three-column table with hairline rules for <CONTENT>. No fills, no shadows, calm and precise.
signature_idea: The fusion bead becomes a contour-line scan on navy, dimensioned like a drawing, set against a big quiet headline and a ruled table.
strengths: striking, distinctive image that still reads as engineering
palette is strictly navy, limestone and white
oversized light headline and hairline table are on-brand
image and table share the calm duotone language
weaknesses: line mesh reads as a wave or fabric, not obviously a PP weld
dimension labels are tiny and partly garbled
table text lists WFI and endotoxin figures, off-offer and invented
no steel-blue accent or mono figures in the table

brand_fit_why: Navy and limestone duotone, light oversized headline and hairline table are on-brand, but the mesh is ambiguous and the table drifts into WFI claims.
